    export PATH

else

    export USE_CCACHE

        "python${py}"     ${_SCONS} ${SCONS_CHECK_PARALLEL}${SCONSOPTS} check
    fi
done



if [ "${USE_CCACHE}" = "true" ]; then
    ccache -s
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build gpsd libs with ASan in the build container.
set -x
pip3 install --break-system-packages scons >/dev/null 2>&1
cd /gt/_work/src
export CC=gcc CXX=g++
scons -j12 minimal=yes nostrip=yes debug_opt=yes shared=no \
  CCFLAGS="-fsanitize=address -O1 -g -fno-omit-frame-pointer" \
  LINKFLAGS="-fsanitize=address" \
  libgpsd libgps_static 2>&1 | tail -30
